a: A closure is a function that remembers variables from its outer scope.
Declarations are hoisted; let/const are in a temporal dead zone until init.
this depends on how a function is called, not where it is defined.
JS objects inherit via the prototype chain.
Events bubble from target up to ancestors unless stopped.
Capture phase runs from root down before the target phase.
Promise.all waits for all promises; fails if any fails.
allSettled waits for all, whether fulfilled or rejected.
WeakMap keys are objects held weakly and can be garbage-collected.
Importing a module can run its top-level code once.
